Folks, look at what we are seeing on our streets. Once again, radical agitators take to the public square under the banner of a so-called “No Kings” rally, and what happens? Complete and utter chaos. This is the bitter fruit of progressive lawlessness—disrespect for authority, contempt for public order, and a total abandonment of personal responsibility. 

Instead of respecting the rule of law and the civic peace that families and hardworking citizens rely on, these mobs packed the streets and squared off with authorities. Thank God for our federal officers and police who stepped in to restore order, using tear gas and making at least 13 arrests confirmed in Portland, Denver and... because when you let radical elements tear down our institutions and defy lawful orders to disperse, civilization itself is put on the line. We need to back the blue, uphold our traditions, and put a stop to this madness once and for all.
